scope: commercial name, public discoverability, game-store collision reconnaissance, trademark and domain preflight

public_reconnaissance.exact_name_web_search: no exact game/app collision surfaced in the public indexed searches performed on 2026-08-12
game_store_searches: Apple App Store indexed web results
public_reconnaissance.note: Search-engine/store reconnaissance is only an early collision screen and is not a legal trademark clearance; confusingly similar marks and unindexed records remain possible.

official_methodology_evidence.inpi: INPI recommends a prior search in the relevant class to identify earlier filed/registered identical or similar marks before filing.
official_methodology_evidence.wipo: WIPO recommends searching existing/pending marks in target markets using the Global Brand Database and national/regional registers.
official_methodology_evidence.wipo_automation_constraint: WIPO Global Brand Database terms/FAQ disallow automated/robot querying; no automated result is represented here as an official registry search.
official_methodology_evidence.wipo_scope_note: Global Brand Database combines international and participating national/regional collections but WIPO still recommends checking national/regional offices directly.

completion_requirements: complete exact and confusingly-similar human search in INPI classes relevant to software/games
complete WIPO/global human cross-check and record material candidates if any
confirm desired domains/social handles or explicitly accept alternatives
record final name decision and any trademark filing strategy
verify store listing name can be created without material collision
